subject: which truecap option fits your next deal?
preheader: free screen, one-time report, or pro workflow—choose by the job.
headline: Choose the smallest TrueCap option that does the job.
body: Use Free when you need a fast first-pass screen: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, cash flow, Deal Score, verdict, and up to 5 saved deals.
Use the one-time Deal Decision Pack when one property needs Max Offer and a complete decision report without a subscription.

Use Pro when you repeatedly need editing, unlimited saves, Buy Box screening, Max Offer, sensitivity, BRRRR and flip models, projections, comparison, and branded reports. Whether the time savings justify it depends on your volume and workflow.
The pricing page is the source of truth for current prices, trial eligibility, billing terms, and any configured campaign offer. Review the checkout total before paying.
